data.name: ProductName
data.comment: The product name. Not translated, kept here so it appears once.

data.name: WindowTitle
data.comment: 0 = product name, 1 = week label, 2 = draft or published state.

data.name: WeekBeginning
data.comment: 0 = the Monday the roster week starts on.

data.name: Starting
data.comment: Shown before the first load finishes.

data.name: Working
data.comment: Shown beside the toolbar while a long action runs.

data.name: NoRosterStored
data.value: No roster stored for the week beginning {0:d MMMM yyyy}.

data.name: NothingToDrawYet
data.value: Importing a sheet and generating a roster arrive in the next change. This screen draws what is already stored.

data.name: CouldNotLoad
data.value: Could not load the roster. See the log for details.
data.comment: Shown instead of a stack trace.

data.name: CouldNotGenerate
data.value: Could not generate the roster. See the log for details.
data.comment: Shown instead of a stack trace.

data.name: CouldNotPrint
data.value: Could not print the roster. See the log for details.
data.comment: Shown instead of a stack trace.

data.name: NothingToPrint
data.comment: Print pressed with no stored roster.

data.name: SentToPrinter
data.comment: Print handed the document to the platform.

data.name: StatusDraft
data.comment: Roster state, shown in the title bar and status bar.

data.name: StatusPublished
data.comment: 0 = version number. A published roster is on a wall somewhere.

data.name: Counts
data.comment: 0 = placed, 1 = unplaced, 2 = overtime, 3 = off. Counted per person per day.

data.name: NoWarnings
data.comment: Warnings summary when there are none.

data.name: WarningsSummary
data.comment: 0 = the errors phrase, 1 = the notices phrase.

data.name: SeverityError
data.comment: Warning severity. The word carries the meaning; styling only makes it findable.

data.name: ContextSeparator
data.comment: Between the date and the line name on a warning.

data.name: RoleLeader
data.comment: One of the three ways a line leader is marked, alongside weight and a filled block.

data.name: ChipEdited
data.comment: Marks an assignment placed by hand rather than by the engine.

data.name: Headcount
data.comment: 0 = assigned, 1 = required. Always both numbers, so short needs no arithmetic.

data.name: LineNeeds
data.comment: 0 = required headcount, on the row header.

data.name: LineShortManyDays
data.comment: 0 = number of days. Row header summary.

data.name: UnknownEmployee
data.comment: An identifier with no employee behind it. Should never appear; saying so beats a blank chip that looks like a rendering fault.

data.name: Lines
data.comment: Title of the line setup screen.

data.name: LineName
data.comment: Watermark on the new line box.

data.name: NoLinesYet
data.value: No production lines yet. A roster needs at least one line to put people on.
data.comment: Empty state on the line setup screen.

data.name: HeadcountNeeded
data.comment: Column header on the line setup screen.

data.name: DisplayOrder
data.comment: Column header. The order lines appear in on screen and on the printed sheet.

data.name: ImportSummary
data.comment: 0 = matched rows, 1 = unresolved rows, 2 = dates found.

data.name: ImportReadyToReview
data.value: Review what the sheet says, then import.

data.name: ImportNothingUsable
data.value: Nothing in this sheet could be used. Check it is the right file and the right layout.

data.name: ImportCouldNotRead
data.value: Could not read that sheet. See the log for details.
data.comment: Shown instead of a stack trace.

data.name: ImportCouldNotCommit
data.value: Could not import. Nothing was written. See the log for details.
data.comment: Commit failed; the whole point is that nothing half-happened.

data.name: ImportCommittedOne
data.comment: Commit succeeded with one temporary employee.

data.name: ImportCommittedMany
data.value: Imported {0} days of availability. {1} people added.

data.name: ImportAddAllAsTemporary
data.comment: Button. A first import has nobody on file, so every row is unmatched.

data.name: ImportUnrecognised
data.value: {0} cells had a mark nothing recognised. They were treated as a day off and are worth a look.

data.name: ImportReason
data.comment: 0 = file name. Written to the audit trail.

data.name: ImportRow
data.comment: 0 = Excel row number, so the operator can go and look at it.

data.name: WarningsHeading
data.comment: Section heading over the warnings panel.

data.name: GettingStartedHeading
data.comment: Section heading on the empty state.

data.name: GettingStartedImport
data.value: 1. Import a sheet — the availability spreadsheet for the week.

data.name: GettingStartedLines
data.value: 2. Set up lines — the production lines people are placed on.

data.name: GettingStartedGenerate
data.value: 3. Generate roster — Linewise fills the lines and tells you what is short.

data.name: LinesColumnHeading
data.comment: Header over the row-header column of the roster grid.

data.name: OperatingAssistantsNeeded
data.value: Operating assistants needed, out of the headcount rather than on top of it
data.comment: Tooltip on the line editor field.

data.name: RoleOperatingAssistant
data.comment: Shown on the chip. The word, not only the colour.

data.name: NavSetUp
data.comment: Sidebar section heading over lines and import.

data.name: NavActions
data.comment: Sidebar section heading over generate and print.

data.name: AddLineShort
data.comment: Sidebar button beside the lines list.

data.name: ManageLines
data.comment: Sidebar button opening the line editor.

data.name: NoLinesSidebar
data.comment: Shown in the sidebar when nothing is configured.

data.name: LineSummary
data.comment: 0 = headcount, 1 = operating assistants. Sidebar line row.

data.name: NavAppearance
data.comment: Sidebar section heading over the theme switch.

data.name: WarningGrouped
data.comment: 0 = count, 1 = the first message. Used when several warnings of one kind fall on one day.

data.name: WarningCount
data.comment: Badge on a grouped warning row.

data.name: PeopleNone
data.comment: The engine may place them anywhere.

data.name: PeopleRank
data.comment: Rank column heading. 1 is first choice.

data.name: PeopleCanLead
data.comment: Permitted to be the line leader.

data.name: PeopleCanAssist
data.comment: Permitted to be the operating assistant.

data.name: PeopleTemporary
data.comment: Marks a temporary employee in the list.

data.name: PeopleNobody
data.value: Nobody on file yet. Import a sheet first.

data.name: RulesPossible
data.value: Nothing impossible. Every line can be filled by somebody.

data.name: NavRosterView
data.comment: Sidebar item for the week grid.

data.name: DashboardNoAvailability
data.value: No sheet imported for this week yet

data.name: DashboardSetupNote
data.value: Set up once. Lines and people are saved, so an ordinary week is import, generate, print.

data.name: NextStepLines
data.value: Add your production lines to get started.

data.name: NextStepPeople
data.value: Import a sheet to bring your people in.

data.name: NextStepGenerate
data.value: Everything is ready. Generate this week's roster.

data.name: NextStepReview
data.value: Roster generated. Review it, then print.

data.name: RoleLineWorker
data.comment: Somebody permitted neither to lead nor to assist.

data.name: CapabilityBreakdown
data.value: {0} can lead · {1} can assist · {2} line workers
